a.content: On the RP2350 the maximum crystal frequency increased from 15 MHz to 50 MHz when the appropriate range is selected in CTRL.FREQ_RANGE.
a.source:
8.2.2. Changes from RP2040
• Maximum crystal frequency increased from 15 MHz to 50 MHz, when appropriate range is selected in CTRL.FREQ_RANGE

b.content: The RP2350 supports 1 MHz to 50 MHz crystals.
b.source: RP2350 supports 1 MHz to 50 MHz crystals and the RP2350 reference design uses a 12 MHz crystal.

notes: Conditional qualification on ONE side only, which LABELLING.md rule 2 qualifier 3 labels compatible and flags. Both statements are about the RP2350 and both name 50 MHz; only a is qualified by a register setting. Nothing in the document says the unqualified statement was meant to exclude the qualified case.
